verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֞ע יִתְר֨וֹ כֹהֵ֤ן מִדְיָן֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ לְמֹשֶׁ֔ה וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַמּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ הוֹצִ֧יא יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ yiṯ·rōw ḵō·hên miḏ·yān ḥō·ṯên mō·šeh ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·mō·šeh ū·lə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘am·mōw kî- hō·w·ṣî Yah·weh ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Now Moses’ father-in-law Jethro the priest of Midian heard about all that God had done for Moses and His people Israel and how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt
verses.literalPt: ORA Jetro, sacerdote de Midiã, sogro de Moisés, ouviu todas as coisas que Deus tinha feito a Moisés e a Israel seu povo, como o SENHOR tinha tirado a Israel do Egito.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֗ח יִתְרוֹ֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־ צִפֹּרָ֖ה אֵ֣שֶׁת מֹשֶׁ֑ה אַחַ֖ר שִׁלּוּחֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ yiṯ·rōw ḥō·ṯên mō·šeh ’eṯ- ṣip·pō·rāh ’ê·šeṯ mō·šeh ’a·ḥar šil·lū·ḥe·hā
verses.literal: After Moses had sent back his wife Zipporah his father-in-law Jethro had received her
verses.literalPt: E Jetro, sogro de Moisés, tomou a Zípora, a mulher de Moisés, depois que ele lha enviara,

verses.original: וְאֵ֖ת שְׁנֵ֣י בָנֶ֑יהָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שֵׁ֤ם הָֽאֶחָד֙ גֵּֽרְשֹׁ֔ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר גֵּ֣ר הָיִ֔יתִי בְּאֶ֖רֶץ נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ šə·nê ḇā·ne·hā ’ă·šer šêm hā·’e·ḥāḏ gê·rə·šōm kî ’ā·mar gêr hā·yî·ṯî bə·’e·reṣ nā·ḵə·rî·yāh
verses.literal: along with her two sons One son was named Gershom for Moses had said I have been a foreigner in a foreign land
verses.literalPt: Com seus dois filhos, dos quais um se chamava Gérson; porque disse: Eu fui peregrino em terra estranha;

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֥ם הָאֶחָ֖ד אֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י אָבִי֙ בְּעֶזְרִ֔י וַיַּצִּלֵ֖נִי מֵחֶ֥רֶב פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer kî- ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ā·ḇî bə·‘ez·rî way·yaṣ·ṣi·lê·nî mê·ḥe·reḇ par·‘ōh
verses.literal: The other son was named Eliezer for Moses had said The God of my father was my helper and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: E o outro se chamava Eliézer; porque disse: O Deus de meu pai foi por minha ajuda, e me livrou da espada de Faraó.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֞א יִתְר֨וֹ חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֛ה וּבָנָ֥יו וְאִשְׁתּ֖וֹ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה אֶל־ הַמִּדְבָּ֗ר אֲשֶׁר־ ה֛וּא חֹנֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yiṯ·rōw ḥō·ṯên mō·šeh ū·ḇā·nāw wə·’iš·tōw ’el- mō·šeh ’el- ham·miḏ·bār ’ă·šer- hū ḥō·neh šām har hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Moses’ father-in-law Jethro along with Moses’ wife and sons came to him in the desert where he was encamped . . . at the mountain of God
verses.literalPt: Vindo, pois, Jetro, o sogro de Moisés, com seus filhos e com sua mulher, a Moisés no deserto, ao monte de Deus, onde se tinha acampado,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲנִ֛י חֹתֶנְךָ֥ יִתְר֖וֹ בָּ֣א אֵלֶ֑יךָ וְאִ֨שְׁתְּךָ֔ וּשְׁנֵ֥י בָנֶ֖יהָ עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh ’ă·nî ḥō·ṯen·ḵā yiṯ·rōw bā ’ê·le·ḵā wə·’iš·tə·ḵā ū·šə·nê ḇā·ne·hā ‘im·māh
verses.literal: He sent word to Moses I your father-in-law Jethro am coming to you with your wife and her two sons
verses.literalPt: Disse a Moisés: Eu, teu sogro Jetro, venho a ti, com tua mulher e seus dois filhos com ela.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִקְרַ֣את חֹֽתְנ֗וֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּ֙חוּ֙ וַיִּשַּׁק־ ל֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁאֲל֥וּ אִישׁ־ לְרֵעֵ֖הוּ לְשָׁל֑וֹם וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ הָאֹֽהֱלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê mō·šeh liq·raṯ ḥō·ṯə·nōw way·yiš·ta·ḥū way·yiš·šaq- lōw way·yiš·’ă·lū ’îš- lə·rê·‘ê·hū lə·šā·lō·wm way·yā·ḇō·’ū hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh
verses.literal: So Moses . . . went out to meet his father-in-law and bowed down and kissed him They greeted . . . each other and went into the tent
verses.literalPt: Então saiu Moisés ao encontro de seu sogro, e inclinou-se, e beijou-o, e perguntaram um ao outro como estavam, e entraram na tenda.

verses.original: וַיְסַפֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ לְחֹ֣תְנ֔וֹ אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְפַרְעֹ֣ה וּלְמִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ל אוֹדֹ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַתְּלָאָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מְצָאָ֣תַם בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וַיַּצִּלֵ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·sap·pêr mō·šeh lə·ḥō·ṯə·nōw ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh lə·p̄ar·‘ōh ū·lə·miṣ·ra·yim ‘al ’ō·w·ḏōṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’êṯ kāl- hat·tə·lā·’āh ’ă·šer mə·ṣā·’ā·ṯam bad·de·reḵ way·yaṣ·ṣi·lêm Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Moses recounted to his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake all the hardships they had encountered along the way and how the LORD had delivered them
verses.literalPt: E Moisés contou a seu sogro todas as coisas que o SENHOR tinha feito a Faraó e aos egípcios por amor de Israel, e todo o trabalho que passaram no caminho, e como o SENHOR os livrara.

verses.original: וַיִּ֣חַדְּ יִתְר֔וֹ עַ֚ל כָּל־ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִצִּיל֖וֹ מִיַּ֥ד מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥad yiṯ·rōw ‘al kāl- haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh lə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer hiṣ·ṣî·lōw mî·yaḏ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: And Jethro rejoiced over all the good things the LORD had done for Israel whom He had rescued from the hand of the Egyptians
verses.literalPt: E alegrou-se Jetro de todo o bem que o SENHOR tinha feito a Israel, livrando-o da mão dos egípcios.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֮ יִתְרוֹ֒ בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצִּ֥יל אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִיַּ֥ד מִצְרַ֖יִם וּמִיַּ֣ד פַּרְעֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִצִּיל֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת יַד־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yiṯ·rōw bā·rūḵ Yah·weh ’ă·šer hiṣ·ṣîl ’eṯ·ḵem mî·yaḏ miṣ·ra·yim ū·mî·yaḏ par·‘ōh ’ă·šer hiṣ·ṣîl ’eṯ- hā·‘ām mit·ta·ḥaṯ yaḏ- miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Jethro declared Blessed be the LORD who has delivered you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh and who has delivered the people from the hand of the Egyptians
verses.literalPt: E Jetro disse: Bendito seja o SENHOR, que vos livrou das mãos dos egípcios e da mão de Faraó; que livrou a este povo de debaixo da mão dos egípcios.

verses.original: עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּֽי־ גָד֥וֹל יְהוָ֖ה מִכָּל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י בַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר זָד֖וּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- ḡā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh mik·kāl hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm kî ḇad·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer zā·ḏū ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods for He did this when they treated Israel with arrogance . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora sei que o SENHOR é maior que todos os deuses; porque na coisa em que se ensoberbeceram, os sobrepujou.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח יִתְר֨וֹ חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֛ה עֹלָ֥ה וּזְבָחִ֖ים לֵֽאלֹהִ֑ים וַיָּבֹ֨א אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְכֹ֣ל׀ זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֶאֱכָל־ לֶ֛חֶם עִם־ חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ yiṯ·rōw ḥō·ṯên mō·šeh ‘ō·lāh ū·zə·ḇā·ḥîm lê·lō·hîm way·yā·ḇō ’a·hă·rōn wə·ḵōl ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl le·’ĕ·ḵāl- le·ḥem ‘im- ḥō·ṯên mō·šeh lip̄·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Then Moses’ father-in-law Jethro brought a burnt offering and sacrifices to God and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law in the presence of God
verses.literalPt: Então Jetro, o sogro de Moisés, tomou holocausto e sacrifícios para Deus; e veio Arão, e todos os anciãos de Israel, para comerem pão com o sogro de Moisés diante de Deus.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב מֹשֶׁ֖ה לִשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם וַיַּעֲמֹ֤ד הָעָם֙ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִן־ הַבֹּ֖קֶר עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ way·yê·šeḇ mō·šeh liš·pōṭ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ hā·‘ām ‘al- mō·šeh min- hab·bō·qer ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: The next day Moses took his seat to judge the people and they stood . . . around him from morning until evening
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, no outro dia, Moisés assentou-se para julgar o povo; e o povo estava em pé diante de Moisés desde a manhã até à tarde.

verses.original: וַיַּרְא֙ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֖ה לָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָֽה־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה עֹשֶׂה֙ לָעָ֔ם מַדּ֗וּעַ אַתָּ֤ה יוֹשֵׁב֙ לְבַדֶּ֔ךָ וְכָל־ הָעָ֛ם נִצָּ֥ב עָלֶ֖יךָ מִן־ בֹּ֥קֶר עַד־ עָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ḥō·ṯên mō·šeh ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer- hū ‘ō·śeh lā·‘ām way·yō·mer māh- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’ă·šer ’at·tāh ‘ō·śeh lā·‘ām mad·dū·a‘ ’at·tāh yō·wō·šêḇ lə·ḇad·de·ḵā wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘ā·le·ḵā min- bō·qer ‘aḏ- ‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people he asked What is this that you are doing for the people Why do you sit alone as judge with all the people standing around you from morning till evening
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, o sogro de Moisés tudo o que ele fazia ao povo, disse: Que é isto, que tu fazes ao povo? Por que te assentas só, e todo o povo está em pé diante de ti, desde a manhã até à tarde?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה לְחֹתְנ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ יָבֹ֥א אֵלַ֛י הָעָ֖ם לִדְרֹ֥שׁ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh lə·ḥō·ṯə·nōw kî- yā·ḇō ’ê·lay hā·‘ām liḏ·rōš ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Because the people come to me to inquire of God Moses replied
verses.literalPt: Então disse Moisés a seu sogro: É porque este povo vem a mim, para consultar a Deus;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָהֶ֤ם דָּבָר֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔י וְשָׁ֣פַטְתִּ֔י בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ וּבֵ֣ין רֵעֵ֑הוּ וְהוֹדַעְתִּ֛י אֶת־ חֻקֵּ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וְאֶת־ תּוֹרֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yih·yeh lā·hem dā·ḇār bā ’ê·lay wə·šā·p̄aṭ·tî bên ’îš ū·ḇên rê·‘ê·hū wə·hō·w·ḏa‘·tî ’eṯ- ḥuq·qê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·’eṯ- tō·w·rō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Whenever they have . . . a dispute it is brought to me to judge between one man . . . and another and I make known to them the statutes and laws of God
verses.literalPt: Quando tem algum negócio vem a mim, para que eu julgue entre um e outro e lhes declare os estatutos de Deus e as suas leis.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר חֹתֵ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֵלָ֑יו לֹא־ טוֹב֙ הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ḥō·ṯên mō·šeh ’ê·lāw lō- ṭō·wḇ had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer ’at·tāh ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: But Moses’ father-in-law said to him What you are doing is not good
verses.literalPt: O sogro de Moisés, porém, lhe disse: Não é bom o que fazes.

verses.original: נָבֹ֣ל תִּבֹּ֔ל גַּם־ אַתָּ֕ה גַּם־ הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמָּ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ כָבֵ֤ד מִמְּךָ֙ הַדָּבָ֔ר לֹא־ תוּכַ֥ל עֲשֹׂ֖הוּ לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḇōl tib·bōl gam- ’at·tāh gam- hā·‘ām haz·zeh ’ă·šer ‘im·māḵ kî- ḵā·ḇêḏ mim·mə·ḵā had·dā·ḇār lō- ṯū·ḵal ‘ă·śō·hū lə·ḇad·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Surely you and these people with you will wear yourselves out . . . because the task is too heavy for you You cannot . . . handle it alone
verses.literalPt: Totalmente desfalecerás, assim tu como este povo que está contigo; porque este negócio é mui difícil para ti; tu só não o podes fazer.

verses.original: עַתָּ֞ה שְׁמַ֤ע בְּקֹלִי֙ אִיעָ֣צְךָ֔ וִיהִ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּ֑ךְ הֱיֵ֧ה אַתָּ֣ה לָעָ֗ם מ֚וּל הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ אַתָּ֛ה אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh šə·ma‘ bə·qō·lî ’î·‘ā·ṣə·ḵā wî·hî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘im·māḵ hĕ·yêh ’at·tāh lā·‘ām mūl hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·hê·ḇê·ṯā ’at·tāh ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Now listen to me . . . I will give you some advice and may God be with you You must be the people’s representative before God and bring . . . their causes to Him
verses.literalPt: Ouve agora minha voz, eu te aconselharei, e Deus será contigo. Sê tu pelo povo diante de Deus, e leva tu as causas a Deus;

verses.original: וְהִזְהַרְתָּ֣ה אֶתְהֶ֔ם אֶת־ הַחֻקִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַתּוֹרֹ֑ת וְהוֹדַעְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֗ם אֶת־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ יֵ֣לְכוּ בָ֔הּ וְאֶת־ הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֽׂוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiz·har·tāh ’eṯ·hem ’eṯ- ha·ḥuq·qîm wə·’eṯ- hat·tō·w·rōṯ wə·hō·w·ḏa‘·tā lā·hem ’eṯ- had·de·reḵ yê·lə·ḵū ḇāh wə·’eṯ- ham·ma·‘ă·śeh ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śūn
verses.literal: Teach them the statutes and laws and show them the way to live - and the work they must do
verses.literalPt: E declara-lhes os estatutos e as leis, e faze-lhes saber o caminho em que devem andar, e a obra que devem fazer.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה תֶחֱזֶ֣ה מִכָּל־ הָ֠עָם אַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֜יִל יִרְאֵ֧י אֱלֹהִ֛ים אַנְשֵׁ֥י אֱמֶ֖ת שֹׂ֣נְאֵי בָ֑צַע וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ עֲלֵהֶ֗ם שָׂרֵ֤י אֲלָפִים֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֔וֹת שָׂרֵ֥י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י עֲשָׂרֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ṯe·ḥĕ·zeh mik·kāl hā·‘ām ’an·šê- ḥa·yil yir·’ê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’an·šê ’ĕ·meṯ śō·nə·’ê ḇā·ṣa‘ wə·śam·tā ‘ă·lê·hem śā·rê ’ă·lā·p̄îm śā·rê mê·’ō·wṯ śā·rê ḥă·miš·šîm wə·śā·rê ‘ă·śā·rōṯ
verses.literal: Furthermore select capable men from among the people God-fearing . . . . . . trustworthy men who are averse to dishonest gain Appoint them over the people as leaders of thousands . . . of hundreds . . . of fifties . . . and of tens
verses.literalPt: E tu dentre todo o povo procura homens capazes, tementes a Deus, homens de verdade, que odeiem a avareza; e põe-nos sobre eles por maiorais de mil, maiorais de cem, maiorais de cinqüenta, e maiorais de dez;

verses.original: וְשָׁפְט֣וּ אֶת־ הָעָם֮ בְּכָל־ עֵת֒ וְהָיָ֞ה כָּל־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַגָּדֹל֙ יָבִ֣יאוּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְכָל־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַקָּטֹ֖ן יִשְׁפְּטוּ־ הֵ֑ם וְהָקֵל֙ מֵֽעָלֶ֔יךָ וְנָשְׂא֖וּ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·p̄ə·ṭū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ wə·hā·yāh kāl- had·dā·ḇār hag·gā·ḏōl yā·ḇî·’ū ’ê·le·ḵā wə·ḵāl had·dā·ḇār haq·qā·ṭōn yiš·pə·ṭū- hêm wə·hā·qêl mê·‘ā·le·ḵā wə·nā·śə·’ū ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: Have these men judge the people at all times Then they can bring you any major issue but all minor cases they can judge on their own so that your load may be lightened . . . as they share it with you
verses.literalPt: Para que julguem este povo em todo o tempo; e seja que todo o negócio grave tragam a ti, mas todo o negócio pequeno eles o julguem; assim a ti mesmo te aliviarás da carga, e eles a levarão contigo.

verses.original: אִ֣ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְצִוְּךָ֣ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְיָֽכָלְתָּ֖ עֲמֹ֑ד וְגַם֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־ מְקֹמ֖וֹ יָבֹ֥א בְשָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ta·‘ă·śeh wə·ṣiw·wə·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·yā·ḵā·lə·tā ‘ă·mōḏ wə·ḡam kāl- hā·‘ām haz·zeh ‘al- mə·qō·mōw yā·ḇō ḇə·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: If you follow this advice and God so directs you then you will be able to endure and all these . . . people can go home in peace
verses.literalPt: Se isto fizeres, e Deus to mandar, poderás então subsistir; assim também todo este povo em paz irá ao seu lugar.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע מֹשֶׁ֖ה לְק֣וֹל חֹתְנ֑וֹ וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ mō·šeh lə·qō·wl ḥō·ṯə·nōw way·ya·‘aś kōl ’ă·šer ’ā·mār
verses.literal: Moses . . . listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said
verses.literalPt: E Moisés deu ouvidos à voz de seu sogro, e fez tudo quanto tinha dito;

verses.original: וַיִּבְחַ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֤ה אַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֙יִל֙ מִכָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם רָאשִׁ֖ים עַל־ הָעָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֤י אֲלָפִים֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֔וֹת שָׂרֵ֥י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י עֲשָׂרֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·ḥar mō·šeh ’an·šê- ḥa·yil mik·kāl yiś·rā·’êl way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯām rā·šîm ‘al- hā·‘ām śā·rê ’ă·lā·p̄îm śā·rê mê·’ō·wṯ śā·rê ḥă·miš·šîm wə·śā·rê ‘ă·śā·rōṯ
verses.literal: So Moses chose capable men from all Israel and made them heads over the people as leaders of thousands . . . of hundreds . . . of fifties . . . and of tens
verses.literalPt: E escolheu Moisés homens capazes, de todo o Israel, e os pôs por cabeças sobre o povo; maiorais de mil, maiorais de cem, maiorais de cinqüenta e maiorais de dez.

verses.original: וְשָׁפְט֥וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם בְּכָל־ עֵ֑ת אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֤ר הַקָּשֶׁה֙ יְבִיא֣וּן אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְכָל־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַקָּטֹ֖ן יִשְׁפּוּט֥וּ הֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·p̄ə·ṭū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haq·qā·šeh yə·ḇî·’ūn ’el- mō·šeh wə·ḵāl had·dā·ḇār haq·qā·ṭōn yiš·pū·ṭū hêm
verses.literal: And they judged the people at all times they would bring the difficult cases to Moses but any minor issue they would judge themselves
verses.literalPt: E eles julgaram o povo em todo o tempo; o negócio árduo trouxeram a Moisés, e todo o negócio pequeno julgaram eles.

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־ חֹתְנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ ל֖וֹ אֶל־ אַרְצֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·šal·laḥ mō·šeh ’eṯ- ḥō·ṯə·nōw way·yê·leḵ lōw ’el- ’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way and Jethro returned to his own land
verses.literalPt: Então despediu Moisés o seu sogro, o qual se foi à sua terra.
